summary: Switches between panels of related content, one visible at a time, with a row or column of tabs. Four custom elements share state through context.

value.note: Value of the selected tab. When empty, the first enabled tab is selected.

orientation.note: Direction of the tab list. Vertical lists use Arrow Up and Down.

activation.note: automatic selects a tab as soon as it takes focus; manual moves focus only, and Enter or Space selects.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.notes: sb-tabs: lays out the list and the panels, owns the selected value and shares it through context.

default.notes: One sb-tabs-list followed by one sb-tabs-content per tab.

change.note: Fires on the sb-tabs host after a person selects a different tab. Not fired for changes made from code. A change from a form control inside a panel also bubbles to the host: listen with event.target === host (that one has no detail).

selected.trigger: tab value equals the tabs value
selected.note: The line variant shows an indicator bar instead of a filled tab.

focus-visible.trigger: keyboard focus on a tab or panel

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: Tab text. A panel is named by its tab. Name the tab list with aria-label when the context does not.
accessibility.targetSize: Each tab is at least 24px high and wide enough for its text (WCAG 2.5.8).

keyboard.Tab: enters the list on the selected tab, then moves to the selected panel
keyboard.ArrowRight: next enabled tab (previous in right-to-left); wraps
keyboard.ArrowLeft: previous enabled tab (next in right-to-left); wraps
keyboard.ArrowDown: next enabled tab in a vertical list
keyboard.ArrowUp: previous enabled tab in a vertical list

aria: list: role=tablist and aria-orientation set as host attributes (following orientation), unless the author set a role, which is kept
tab: native button with role=tab, aria-selected, one tab stop (roving tabindex, applied to the inner button)
tab: aria-controls through the ariaControlsElements property (an element reference from a shadow root to the light DOM above it resolves; an ID would not)
panel: role=tabpanel as a host attribute, named by its tab with ElementInternals ariaLabelledByElements; where unsupported the tab text is copied into aria-label
panel: tabindex=0 so a panel with no focusable content is reachable by keyboard
references between tabs and panels (aria-controls, ariaLabelledByElements) are re-resolved whenever tabs or panels are added, removed or change value
a value that names no enabled tab (empty, unknown, disabled) selects the first enabled tab
forced colors: the selected tab of the primary variant is Highlight on HighlightText; the line variant draws its indicator in Highlight

elements.summary: The row or column that holds the tabs.

variant.note: primary is a filled track with a raised selected tab; line is transparent with an indicator bar under the selected tab.

elements.notes: Must be a child of sb-tabs. Give it aria-label when the tabs need a name.

elements.summary: One tab. Renders a native button with role tab.

value.note: Links the tab to the panel with the same value. Unique within the tabs.

default.notes: Text, optionally with a decorative icon.

elements.summary: The panel of one tab; only the selected panel is displayed.

value.note: The tab value this panel belongs to.

elements.notes: Must be a descendant of sb-tabs.

useCases.when: Peer views of one object, switched without leaving the page
Sub-navigation inside a page header where a filled track is too heavy

antiPatterns.pattern: Tabs that navigate to other pages
antiPatterns.why: Tab semantics promise a panel on the same page
antiPatterns.alternative: Use links in a navigation landmark

antiPatterns.pattern: Tab labels that wrap into several lines or overflow
antiPatterns.why: The list stops reading as one row and hides tabs
antiPatterns.alternative: Shorten the labels or use fewer tabs

coverage: tablist, tab and panel roles; only the selected panel displayed
value selects; first enabled tab by default
change detail, bubbles, composed, not for code changes; a slotted control's change has no detail
one tab stop; Tab reaches the panel
arrows wrap and select, disabled skipped, Home/End
manual activation with Enter and Space
ariaControlsElements and panel name in the accessibility tree
focus ring keyboard-only in token color
author role on the list kept; value naming no enabled tab falls back to the first enabled tab; late-added tab or panel is wired
forced colors: selected tab and line indicator

drift.realization: the visual reference uses a translucent ring plus border; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
the visual reference uses foreground in light and muted-foreground in dark

drift.contract: background fill with the small shadow in both modes
drift.realization: the reference uses an input-tinted fill and a border in dark

drift.contract: stretches to the list's inner height (30px in the 36px list)
drift.realization: the reference subtracts 1px for its transparent border

drift.contract: tabIndex on the sb-tabs-trigger host is forwarded to the inner button
drift.realization: keeps the generic host free of tabindex so axe sees tab as an owned child of tablist

drift.contract: tablist and tabpanel as host attributes; panel name through ElementInternals ariaLabelledByElements
drift.realization: aria-label copy of the tab text where the property is unsupported

the visual reference marks the selected tab with a light fill and shadow only (about 1.3:1 in dark); the selected pill also gets a 3:1 input-colored border in the default variant; the line variant keeps its indicator (WCAG 1.4.11)

coverage: Tabs: 12 variant(s), Orientation (Horizontal, Vertical) x State (Rest, Focus) x Selected (False, True) x Disabled (False, True); read back ok
TabsList: 6 variant(s), Variant (Primary, Line) x Active (1, 2, 3); read back ok

drift.contract: Size of an icon slotted in a tab.
drift.realization: Content the person using it places (a slotted icon, image or control); the library sample shows text only.

openQuestions.question: Which element carries tabindex for roving focus?
openQuestions.answer: The inner button. The roving-focus controller works on the sb-tabs-trigger hosts (so retargeted key events match), and the host's tabIndex accessor forwards to its button; a tabindex on the generic host breaks the tablist/tab ownership check in axe.

openQuestions.question: Cross-root references between tab and panel?
openQuestions.answer: ariaControlsElements on the tab button; ElementInternals ariaLabelledByElements on the panel, with an aria-label copy as fallback.

openQuestions.question: Manual activation?
openQuestions.answer: Offer it as the activation prop; automatic is the default.

openQuestions.question: Event name?
openQuestions.answer: value-change, so native change events from controls inside a panel are not confused with it.

options.name: Third
options.reason: The stories show a third tab (Settings: General, Notifications, Appearance); the code takes any number of triggers.

options.name: Active
options.reason: The selected tab is any of the triggers in the code; the design file draws which one.
